name: retrieval.context
description: Retrieve grounded workspace context for a routine to compose into its own reply.

intent.description: Retrieve workspace evidence for a routine step without composing the final assistant answer.
examples: Find context for the user's latest question.
Gather source chunks before answering inside the routine.

fields.name: query
fields.extractionHint: Use the current user query as the retrieval question unless the routine binds a different query.

outcomes.name: context_ready
outcomes.description: Workspace context was retrieved and staged for the next routine reply.

outcomes.name: no_context
outcomes.description: No workspace context was available; the routine can continue without grounding or ask a follow-up.
